help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Kinolin Translator is a BYOK AI Translation Agent: configure your own API key locally, then translate in the browser.

quickStartSteps.1: Open AI Config, pick a provider, enter a model and API key, then save and test the connection.
quickStartSteps.2: Go to Translator: paste text under Text, or switch to Document and upload a file.
quickStartSteps.3: Use History to search, copy, or restore a past translation.

help.configIntro: Translation is blocked until AI is configured. Open AI Config in the sidebar and follow these steps:

configSteps.1: Choose a provider: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, or OpenAI Compatible.
configSteps.2: Enter the model id (e.g. gpt-4o, deepseek-chat). Compatible also needs a trusted API base URL.
configSteps.3: Paste your API key (it must be typed or pasted; autofill dots alone will not save).
configSteps.4: Tap Save, then Test connection to verify.
configSteps.5: When status shows Configured, you are ready to translate.

configTips.1: API keys stay in this browser only and are never uploaded to Kinolin; calls go straight to the provider.
configTips.2: Do not save keys on shared devices; use Clear key when finished.
configTips.3: Gemini needs reachability to Google. If it keeps failing, try DeepSeek or a Compatible gateway.
configTips.4: For Compatible, only enter API base URLs you trust to avoid phishing.

help.useIntro: After configuration, open Translator → Text. One source can be translated into multiple target languages:

useSteps.1: Paste or type source text (watch the character limit).
useSteps.2: Under Languages, each slot is one target; tap + to add more. Optionally enable Switch the whole UI (single target only).
useSteps.3: Choose a style: Default, Natural, Casual, Business, Formal, Technical, Academic, or Localized.
useSteps.4: Tap Translate. For multiple languages, results show language tabs and online preview.
useSteps.5: Copy the active translation, or Retranslate with the current settings. Batch runs are saved under History → Text as one group.

help.documentIntro: On Translator, open the Document tab. One source file can be translated into multiple target languages at once. Files are parsed locally, then sent in chunks to your AI.

documentSteps.1: Make sure AI is configured (same provider and key as text translation).
documentSteps.2: Drop or choose a file (TXT / Markdown / HTML / DOCX).
documentSteps.3: Under Languages, each slot is one target; tap + to add as many as you need. Then pick a style.
documentSteps.4: Tap Translate. Progress shows the current language and chunk. Afterwards switch language tabs, open Preview, or download the current / all languages.
documentSteps.5: Batch results are saved under History → Document as one grouped batch, separate from text entries.

documentTips.1: Keep each file under about 2 MB and 80k characters. There is no cap on target languages, but more languages mean more API calls and time.
documentTips.2: Fenced Markdown code blocks are left as-is when possible.
documentTips.3: DOCX is extracted as plain text and downloaded as .txt. PDF is not supported yet.
documentTips.4: Filter History by Text / Document. Batch jobs show as Batch · N langs with per-language preview or delete-all.

help.historyBody: Text and document entries are separated. Use All / Text / Document at the top. Text or document batch jobs stay grouped (one batch, multiple language tabs) so they do not mix with single entries. Up to about 100 entries; search, filter by target language, preview, copy, or delete. Clear respects the active category.
help.uiLangBody: Use the top-right language dropdown to switch ready UI languages. Chinese and English are built-in; generate other packs under Settings with your AI, then apply them from the dropdown. Enabling Switch the whole UI to the target language only switches when that pack is already generated.
help.followUiPackMissing: That UI locale pack is not generated yet. Generate it under Settings first.

faq.q1: Why does Translate open Configure AI?
faq.a1: The Translation Agent needs a provider, model, and API key. Open AI Config, save, and preferably test the connection.
faq.a2: Make sure the key was typed or pasted. Browser autofill dots alone do not write a real key. Save again and refresh.
faq.q3: How do I translate into multiple languages at once?
faq.a3: In Text or Document, add target languages with + under Languages, then Translate. Switch language tabs to preview or open Preview. History keeps them under Text / Document as batch groups.
faq.a4: Usage is billed to your provider account (BYOK). More target languages and longer documents mean more calls.
